coverage.assessment: Official issuer and technical sources, global and Asian multilingual discovery, on-site reports, model catalog checks, specialist embodied and industrial AI channels, and independent search were compared. Original regional event time remains uncertain where reposts, inaccessible social pages or dated indexes are the only observation. Mandarin manufacturer and sector reporting, Korean reports and first-party releases, Japanese product and trade sources, and open English/European discovery surfaced announcements outside named vendors. Shenzhen and Guangzhou demos, issuer-reported line deployment, distribution maturity and inaugural availability were separated. Later digest dates for MONAKA, CaoCao, DeepL, Concierto, Sakana Namazu follow-ups and GigaChat did not move the events into this issue.

Financing and acquisitions searched across company, investor, regulatory and specialist news surfaces in English and regional languages, including Chinese robotics capital. Exact closing dates and terms were not assumed from articles. Some direct original press pages were unavailable; timed syndicated or regulator sources were checked where available. Direct company and investor statements, German public merger reporting, Shenzhen/China robotics finance, and financial specialist reporting were checked. Tesla’s event is its public record/reporting, while the application predates it. Dayan is attributed original disclosure of a recently completed round; the round’s exact close is unknown. Zerith’s original exactly at the opening was excluded even though later syndications carry in-window clocks. Recent round rumors and stale fundraising were held or excluded.

Author and lab pages, original papers and version histories, journal metadata and RSS, non-arXiv paths and multilingual discovery were inspected. US holiday batch scheduling and current feed contents were verified; first-public timing cannot be backfilled from submission or indexing. Publisher pages/RSS and DOI records, labs/author materials, selected article and preprint versions, and actual cs.AI/cs.CL public listing/RSS contents were checked alongside specialist and regional indexes. The Thanksgiving schedule and matching older listing IDs constrain what the feed date can prove. Hugging Face’s dated engineering write-up is a distinct result; the accepted clinical paper’s publication clock stays in the uncertainty bucket and figures are restricted to its task.

Regulator/issuer indexes and mainland Chinese, Korean, European, Japanese and international reporting included draft policy, civil dates, exact releases and project standards. Public calendar dates were not cast as exact times. Public policy notices with a prior announcement were separated from actual consultation steps. Mainland and regional official or specialist channels, German filing context, EU and French official notices, Korean consultation schedule, Japan ministry briefing, and UK, North American and Spanish-language discovery were investigated. A dated consultation, formal publication, original announcement and policy effect are distinct. The older Japan Defence AI Vision is dated as a prior-window retrospective; the French joint announcement is timed and the Korean/EU boundaries remain visible.

Agent protocol and product searches, changelogs, public code/release metadata and app-industry paths include both independent developer tooling and major vendors. Availability, version and naming ambiguity remained where original terms or platform access could not be pinned. Issuer changelogs and source plus local-language and independent-maker discovery included GitHub, regional reports, vendor and community project pages beyond the large labs. Copilot and Pi stable releases, Lablup’s local product release and Kimi public canary are distinct. Neither shared protocol terminology nor namesake products resolve OSC, JEV or Laya; model or tool safety is not inferred from an announcement.

discovery.assessment: Multiple independent multilingual search paths included company/lab updates, public records, standards portals, commercial and local press, specialist robotics and developer channels and original research. Raw event inventories and screening are audit evidence, not exhaustive news discovery. Independent coverage review read all 624 stored dispositions and the exact proposed MDX, with 83 independently logged searches and 111 independently logged opens. The merged record contains 336 searches in 14 recorded language fields, 630 openings and 70 metadata checks, and 578 readable, 820 search-only and 85 failed observations. The 14 confirmed items and 3 visible boundary observations match the draft; 159 exclusions and 448 held leads stay outside those counts. Read and reconciled material independent results from industry, issuer and specialised research sources across all five topics, including unmatched index routes, repeated syndicated stories and earlier logged exclusions. The limitations are specific to accessible indexed sources and event clocks. This verdict does not use candidate-file size as a coverage proxy.

findings.detail: Additional open discovery found dated regulator and Chinese industrial reporting that the original seed leads alone would have missed. EMAG, Dayan and the AI Office call were independently read and compared with overlapping publications. The draft covers substantive agent deployment and engineering research alongside the robotics stories.

Reconciled materially new lead titles against issuer timing or candidate dispositions, including Fujitsu, Concierto, CaoCao, DeepL, Firebird, Japan Defense AI Vision, OpenRouter, earlier preprints and press reprints. The final text visibly identifies prior-window items outside new-event and watch counts.

Latest independent release follow-up included the publicly distributed Kimi 2.9.0 canary without assuming stable availability. The final issue distinguishes the date of artifacts, capability demonstrations, user-facing authorization, phased release and public reporting.

The direct Reuters article, several social and trade pages, Korean draft portal and some model artifact endpoints did not provide usable direct reads. Readable attributed syndications, official embeds and actual accessible originals were recorded where allowed. Remaining timing and access limits are retained with the appropriate observation.

The signed-off result is bounded by public multilingual query/index lag, publisher access and the holiday arXiv bulletin schedule. A timestamp for an RSS refresh, DOI deposit, current listing or dated recap does not establish initial public release. Unresolved identity aliases and prior temporal leads remain explicitly unresolved.

article.limitations: Chinese platform originals are sometimes unavailable directly; only accessible attributed reports or public first-party evidence support publication. Initial research availability can straddle the day boundary; US Thanksgiving changed arXiv batching; regional and specialist publisher search/index coverage remains incomplete. JEV, Laya and OSC identities remain unconfirmed.
